text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyoneeeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...So much happened this year. 
Races, concerts, really so many things!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of them was connected to 
our dreams and goals, 
which is why we gave everything we had to 
face them!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And through it all, you were there 
supporting us. 
You gave us cheers packed full of heart.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... we're still on our journey toward 
our dreams... 
And we'll keep on running from here on 
out...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
So please, continue to cheer for us...! 
We'll run our best, aiming to be Umamusume 
you'll want to support even more...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone! It's almost time for 
the countdown! 
Please look at the digital clock!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
10 seconds left... Join in, everyone... 
7, 6, 5, 4—

text_block_list.name: Everyone in the Venue
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year~~~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Look at all these people! 
Kicking off the new year with a big crowd 
is the only way to do it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you always come alive in places like 
this, Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Look who's talking! You're super excited 
to do your usual thing too, aren't you, 
Dia?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Drawing a fortune and breaking 
the jinx! Even if I draw the worst luck, 
I'll shatter it without fail!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Guy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kita-chan and company! We're about to 
have a New Year's wadaiko performance. 
Care to beat the drums with us?

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Lady
text_block_list.text:
We'd love to see you girls giving those 
drums your all! Start off the new year 
with a real big bang!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Wherever there's a festival, 
that's where I'll be! Let's all have a 
blast together!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Nature-chan! That looks great on 
you! All that shopping we did across the 
district was totally worth it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha... I mean, I do think it's a super 
cute outfit, really! But still... I'm 
totally sticking out like a sore thumb 
here, right?! Big time!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That is the wrong way to put it! A more 
accurate description would be—yes, 
fortissimo!! You are playing the main 
melody with such power that those walking 
beside you simply fade into the 
background...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, Nature! You're stealing the 
show! Going all out right from the new 
year!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Guy
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's dying to see that outfit of 
yours! Make sure to take a walk through 
the shopping district later, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...At this point, I'm practically a 
mascot. But, well... it's nice that they 
care enough to dote on me, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... what a massive crowd... I figured 
as much since it's Hatsumode, but... huh?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Cheval, is it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Are you here for Hatsumode too, 
Duramente-san...? That's... kind of 
unexpected...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I mean... you're so strong, Duramente-san, 
so I didn't think you'd need to pray for 
good fortune or anything...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I did not come to pray for victory. I 
came to declare that I will remain 'the 
strongest,' so as not to bring shame upon 
my family's name.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...That's amazing, thinking like that. But 
that's just who you are, Duramente-san. I 
wish... I could think like that, even a 
little...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...There is no need. We each possess our 
own strengths. There is no reason to 
imitate others.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... haha, yeah, you're right...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
My, look whose familiar faces I've 
spotted! If it isn't the two rising stars 
in popularity!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Royce-san...! R-Rising stars, you say...? 
I'm still nowhere near...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No need to be modest when the data says 
otherwise. I'll just have to ride the wave 
of your momentum myself!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely. To claim the title of 'the 
strongest,' strength alone isn't enough. 
You must also strive to be unforgettable. 
Just like me!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Unforgettable... That holds true for my 
family as well.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
We have only just stepped up to the 
starting gate. Ahead of us lie countless 
fierce battles and dramas yet to unfold.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Dramas that allow you to become someone's 
'beloved Umamusume'!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah... you're right.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Are you heading back already?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I am going to train. This year's races 
have already begun.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Stealing a march on us is hardly 
praiseworthy! Didn't I just say I'd ride 
your momentum? I'm coming too!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Alright... Me too...!
